caveats.detail: Phase 44K approves readiness metadata only; no live execution is approved.
Live route execution requires a later explicit approval phase.
Phase 44H cost evidence is static planning metadata and not authoritative billing.
Web/desktop profile upload is not implemented or approved.
Phase 44G validates protocol only; no local sidecar process is approved.
Qwen3-VL and vLLM remain excluded from initial internal desktop/hybrid scope.
Demucs remains blocked pending provenance/legal review and is not required for this desktop/hybrid readiness gate.
No broad media, arbitrary media, public artifacts, or production testing is approved.
Track A visual/render/runtime stack remains outside this Track B desktop/hybrid gate.
